title: CSCI 531 — Introduction to Security Measurement
subject: Cybersecurity
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the four practice groups of the Secure Software Development Framework and explain their roles in secure development.
Explain how cryptographic standards define approved algorithms and parameters, and how modes of operation process data.
Apply security reasoning to identify assets, trust boundaries, threats, controls, and residual risk in a software system.
